methodology: Primary-source passage extraction; coordinator inspected all regional claim sets, checked selected original climate-FCV passages, assembled only conditional mediated mechanisms and retained all limitations. Luna performed routine collection and a read-only integrity audit. Human country/source approval remains pending.
source_access: Full-text means the cited publisher text was inspected; official summary access does not imply access to its underlying report. Blocked and metadata-only attempts are excluded from claims.
scope: 60 new countries, including blend and inactive IDA borrowers; eligibility is not FCV status. Existing 24 banks and all 505 baseline tracked files are frozen.

BDI-E-002.reason: Composite modeled risk categories are not observed climate impacts.

TCD-E-001.reason: Modeled present-day 100-year flood exposure is not an observed affected-person count.

HND-E-004.reason: A multi-driver food-security diagnosis does not establish climate-caused violence.

MDG-E-002.reason: The Grand Sud fragility statement is contextual, not a complete climate-conflict mechanism.

MDG-E-006.reason: A disaster displacement count is exposure evidence, without violent-conflict or anthropogenic event attribution.

VCT-E-001.reason: Beryl evacuation and service disruption do not establish violent conflict or event attribution.

KEN-E-002.reason: Government-described resource-conflict mechanism has no event-specific causal estimate.

LSO-E-002.reason: Reported protection-risk mechanism is not a measured effect on violence.

SLB-E-002.reason: Selected-site relocation and land-access mechanism is conditional, without national causal attribution.

STP-E-004.reason: Maritime-crime analogy from elsewhere in the Gulf of Guinea cannot establish local incidence.

TGO-E-004.reason: Reported drought/conflict co-occurrence is not causal event analysis.

pathway_policy: All 14 pathway records are draft analytical-inference mechanisms with link-level evidence and alternative explanations. They are not national causal estimates. All other countries retain explicit gaps.
independent_integrity_audit: Read-only Luna audit: 505/505 baseline file hashes match; zero baseline tracked changes; new test assertions and paths inspected. Full-suite acceptance remains the coordinator's responsibility.
known_tool_limitations: The default root-discovery validator already fails on 23 baseline versioned country roots; explicit versioned validation is used.
One PDF table screenshot attempt failed. Text-level passage checks do not imply a complete visual review of every source PDF.
Some official PDFs were blocked or too large; each affected country's audit identifies the actual alternative text inspected.
not_done: No automatic or human approval of these new records.
No releases/current change, app pin change, merge, deployment, live UI test or paid application-model call.
